notes.title: Small Patch - With EULA
notes.content:
We added a EULA that we ask each player to accept on the start up of our game.  After watching our first few players stream our game it has become apparent that the game might be scarier than we thought and now merits a warning that we want all players to abide by. 

Basically, play at your own risk, this game was made for fun or laughing at your friends but please don't play if you do not accept our terms (you can now see these on start up).  

We also added a toggle grab button, you can now turn grab toggle on or off (default off) in any of the control menus.  If toggle is on, it is how it sounds, pressing the grab button once will grab, pressing and releasing the grab button a second time will release.

We also made the small changes below 

"Make it to 6 AM" changed to "Make it to 6AM....ish" (someone pointed out that they died at 6:01 AM) each night actually ends around 6:15 AM so we wanted to make it clear that the game does not end on the hour to leave the player in dread for a little longer ;) 

Grammatical errors - found a few....sorry

Items were being highlighted (as if they could be grabbed) when an item was already in hand, cleaned this up to make grabbing items a little more clear.


As always if you guys find any issues please let us know, we are still only a two man crew and we will patch the issues as fast as possible. 

Thanks for playing!
